selectionContract: This is a source/shot plan, not an approved final timeline or a render receipt.
Root selects exact from/dur values, verifies durable raw files and fills prepared paths.
from is the original selected interval for provenance; each prepared MP4 must contain exactly dur*30 decoded frames from PTS0.
Native cuts always use from=0 on separately prepared H.264/yuv420p CFR30 1920x1080 MP4s with one AAC stereo source-game audio track.
Reorder/remove/replace these proposed shots after actual viewing. Null trim values intentionally prevent build.
Set status=DRAFT_SELECTED only after actual file selection. Keep publication=DRAFT_ONLY.
The last shot is 2–4 seconds of actual gameplay with original audio; logo/Steam CTA overlays it without an added silent card.
No automatic render, generation, upload or publication. Root owns inspection/render and user review.
